title: SAMPLE: Misrata port berth congestion reported by agents
summary: A sample shipping-agent note described congestion at Misrata. No port authority bulletin was attached.
whatHappened: Two sample agent emails said general-cargo berths at Misrata were congested on 2 September 2026, with waiting times described as 'more than a day'. No official port statement was in the sample set.
whyItMatters: Misrata is a major commercial gateway. Congestion changes feeder schedules and warehouse dwell times for humanitarian and commercial cargo.
watchNext: An official berth report, or evidence that waiting times have fallen.
confidenceRationale: Two similar agent notes; no port-authority confirmation.
